answer: Make each agent seal a unique proof-of-replication to register: it must store a distinct dataset packed as densely as basalt, then pass a per-epoch challenge whose structure is as fixed as a sonnet's fourteen lines, proving it physically holds that exact replica right now. One farm cannot share a single disk across a thousand identities, since every sealed copy costs real space and seal-time, and any attempt to fake or reuse one sends a detectable ripple through the audit beacon. Forging N sybils means provisioning N non-transferable replicas.
